idea: Use an ILP or set-partitioning solver, such as scipy milp, on a k×k cell grid. Each candidate is an a×a axis-aligned block at any position, chosen with a binary variable; constraints are that each cell is covered at most once and that the number of squares chosen equals n. Maximise the sum of a/k, and loop over k from about sqrt(n)−2 to 2·sqrt(n).
